name: agora
description: Agora — hybrid multi-agent resonance simulator (Neo4j + Ollama)
author: Alexander Schneider <https://alexle135.de>

scripts.setup:frontend: bun install && cd frontend && bun install
scripts.setup:all: bun run setup:frontend && bun run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check app/ tests/
scripts.check: bun run lint:backend && bun run test:backend && bun run lint:frontend && bun run test:frontend && bun run build:frontend
